source: Export an icon, Base64 text or ASCII art. Exporting keeps the current image and its Save destination unchanged.
revised_candidate: သူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇပဵၼ်ဢၢႆႇၵွၼ်ႇ၊ လိၵ်ႈ Base64 ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် ႁၢင်ႈဢၼ်တႅမ်ႈလူၺ်ႈတူဝ်လိၵ်ႈ ASCII။ ၵၢၼ်သူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇၼႆႉ ဢမ်ႇလႅၵ်ႈလၢႆႈႁၢင်ႈယၢမ်းလဵဝ် လႄႈတီႈသိမ်းမၼ်း။

backtranslation: Export an icon, Base64 text, or an image made using ASCII characters. Exporting does not change the current image or its Save destination.
